messages:
jordan_sales: Quick sync — OperaAI POC wrapped yesterday. They asked for a 6-week extension and an extra $50k in promo credits to cover embedding volume for the trial period. They said commitment decision will happen at the end of the extension. Anyone blocking this?
mei_se: Can you share the usage pattern? embed qps, peak tokens, and whether they used KV caching?
jordan_sales: They hit bursty embed traffic (peaks ~120 qps for short windows), avg 35 qps. Using default caching; no prefix caching enabled. No PII in vectors (stated).
rama_solutions: From infra side, we can set a quota guardrail and enable prefix/KV caching to reduce cost. If we grant credits, recommend we pair with a config: 
```
- max_embed_qps: 60
- burst_bucket: 2000 tokens
- enable_prefix_cache: true
- alert_threshold: 70% credit burn
```
This keeps them from burning credits in <48h.
katie_finance: Approvals: anything <= $10k we can greenlight in sales. >$10k needs Deal Desk signoff and finance prep (cost delta + expected ARR if they convert). For $50k we need a short form (1-pager) showing conversion probability and onboarding plan.
jordan_sales: Got it. I can draft the 1-pager. Quick ask — can Deal Desk fast-track if we attach a 12-month 200k commit with monthly cadence? That’s what they hinted at.
deal-desk: You’ll need a commit worksheet and a signed LOI. For promotional credit trade: finance requires a 50% clawback if they churn within 90 days, or we convert credits into committed discount applied to first 3 invoices. Also need legal to approve the fallback language.
oliver_dealsbot: Automated note: Rate card check complete — list price for embed unit is $0.0025/embedding. $50k credits ≈ 20M embeddings. Please confirm host region and enterprise tier for SLA.
mei_se: Region is us-west-2, enterprise tier (they asked for 99.9% SLA). Also security questionnaire done except for data retention TTL detail — they asked if we can enforce 30-day vector TTL during trial.
rama_solutions: We can enforce TTL via private cache policy for the trial. Ops will add a retention rule scoped to their org ID.
katie_finance: Next steps: Jordan — please attach the 1-pager with expected ARR and LOI draft by EOD. Deal Desk — if legal ok with clawback language, finance can pre-approve conditional credits pending LOI.
jordan_sales: Will do. tagging @deal-desk for signoff once LOI ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:
deal-desk: Noted. Schedule a 15-min signoff call? Can do 2pm PT today.
jordan_sales: 2pm PT works for me. Adding the call invite now.
mei_se: I'll join to confirm the cache/TLS details.
katie_finance: I'll be on for the financial terms.
rama_solutions: I'll join briefly to confirm retention rule.
oliver_dealsbot: Reminder: create a customer config ticket for promo-credit tracking — use template: `PROMO-CREDIT-TRACKER` and include org id, credit amount, clawback terms.
jordan_sales: Created ticket #PROMO-8437. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROMO-8437
jordan_sales: Thanks everyone — will post the 1-pager before the call and attach LOI draft.
mei_se: Quick note — if they toggle prefix caching after extension starts, we should re-evaluate remaining credits to avoid surprise underspend.
jordan_sales: Good point. I'll add a clause to the 1-pager requiring configuration lock for first 4 weeks of extension.
katie_finance: Perfect. If call confirms, finance will draft the conditional credit memo for accounting. :white_check_mark:
_meta: generated for dataset: sales POC promo credit approval thread
